title: Open Source Shakespeare (Globe edition of the complete works)
author: William Shakespeare
license_note: The Shakespeare texts are in the public domain; the database, concordance and related data are CC BY-NC 4.0.
notes: The complete works in the 1864 Globe edition (W. G. Clark and W. A. Wright), with a concordance, advanced search, character search and statistics. The text is the modernised spelling of a nineteenth-century edition, not a transcription of the early printings, as with the Folger Shakespeare entry. The site's statistics page gives 43 works and 884,421 words (plays, sonnets and poems), all written between about 1590 and 1613; the counts below are ours, from the downloaded database, with speaker names included. The database can be downloaded as SQL, Access and delimited text files. The site shows © 2003-2026 and a server update on 21 May 2026. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
